zh: 他们说好来吃饭，结果没出现。
old_en: They said they would show up for dinner, but they never ended up coming.
new_en: They said they'd come for dinner, but didn't show up.

zh: 本打算回家，最后去了超市。
old_en: He planned to go home but ended up at the supermarket.
new_en: He planned to go home, but ended up at the supermarket.

zh: 本来打算早点回家，结果加班到深夜。
old_en: I planned to go home early, but ended up working late into the night.
new_en: I planned to go home early, but ended up working late.

zh: 我们约好见面，结果他一直没有出现。
old_en: We agreed to meet, but he never showed up.
new_en: We agreed to meet, but he never showed up.

zh: 本来打算坐一会儿，结果待了一下午。
old_en: I intended to sit for a while, but ended up staying all afternoon.
new_en: I planned to sit for a while, but ended up staying all afternoon.

zh: 原计划只看一集电视剧，结果看了三集才睡。
old_en: Originally, I planned to watch one episode of a TV series, but ended up sleeping after three.
new_en: I planned to watch one episode, but ended up watching three before sleeping.

zh: 本来打算坐地铁，结果骑了自行车。
old_en: I was going to take the subway, but ended up riding a bike instead.
new_en: I planned to take the subway, but ended up riding a bike.

zh: 聚会来了很多人，到最后也没见到他。
old_en: The party showed up many people, but he ended up not being there.
new_en: Many people came to the party, but I didn't see him.

zh: 聚会来了很多人，结果一个老朋友没来。
old_en: The party showed up many people, but my old friend ended up not coming.
new_en: Many people came to the party, but my old friend didn't show up.

zh: 聚会来了很多人，结果有人迟到了一个小时。
old_en: The party ended up having many people, but some showed up an hour late.
new_en: Many people came to the party, but someone was an hour late.

zh: 开会时他迟到了，最后终于出现了。
old_en: He showed up late for the meeting, but finally ended up attending.
new_en: He was late for the meeting but finally showed up.

zh: 他们说好上午来，结果下午才出现。
old_en: They said they would come in the morning, but ended up showing up in the afternoon.
new_en: They said they would come in the morning, but showed up in the afternoon.

zh: 原计划直接回家，结果去朋友家了。
old_en: I had planned to go straight home, but ended up at a friend's place.
new_en: I planned to go straight home, but ended up at a friend's place.

zh: 买了一件没打算买的东西，结果钱包空了。
old_en: I ended up with an empty wallet after buying something I hadn't planned to buy.
new_en: I bought something I didn't plan to buy, and now my wallet is empty.

zh: 本来只想逛逛，结果买了两件衣服。
old_en: I just wanted to browse, but ended up buying two pieces of clothing.
new_en: I just wanted to look around, but ended up buying two pieces of clothing.

zh: 他本来迷路了，最后还是走到了公园。
old_en: He got lost at first but eventually ended up in the park.
new_en: He got lost at first but still made it to the park.

zh: 她本来在街上转悠，结果迷路了。
old_en: She was wandering in the street and ended up getting lost.
new_en: She was wandering on the street and ended up getting lost.

zh: 会议快开始了，结果主持人还没到。
old_en: The meeting was about to start, but the host ended up not showing up.
new_en: The meeting was about to start, but the host didn't show up.

zh: 他们说好十一点到，结果十二点才出现。
old_en: They said they would arrive at eleven, but ended up showing up at twelve.
new_en: They said they'd arrive at eleven, but showed up at twelve.

zh: 本来打算和朋友一起回家，结果他先一步到了小区。
old_en: He was supposed to meet friends, but ended up arriving at the community first.
new_en: I planned to go home with a friend, but he got to the neighborhood first.
